content: Kǝ yi ɓǝra lari vanyi madiya waladi a vǝr shida sara dǝmǝlmau, kǝra dlama zǝwar nyi, ǝnga shamba adabanga kǝra ja. Bama ja ǝnggǝr pǝci, hiya ja tsu ǝnggǝr shimal uˈu.
Aˈyi ja ǝnga zǝr lǝkakaɗǝ pǝpǝɗau wu tsa ja kǝra papahau. Kǝ ji fiya hi mazǝma ja a gwar dǝl ǝnga hi matsala ja ar ˈyiˈyi.
Ji sǝya mala wau kǝra ma gǝ nggari dǝgǝ abǝr nǝ lǝvari. Ənga ǝnggǝra ji wau, ba dlǝɗǝ pamǝpamǝ mǝɗǝfǝ kǝ dlǝwubiya.
Ənggǝra dlǝɗǝ pamǝpamǝ mǝɗǝfǝ kǝ dlǝwubiya, yu yiwu ya tsǝfǝya, ama ba yi nggari ɗahǝ sara dǝmǝlmǝ a vǝr na, “Ga haɗiya sǝra dlǝɗǝ mǝɗǝfǝ kǝ nana, ga sara tsǝfǝ mai.”
Kǝ waladi ta yi lari taˈyi a gwar dǝl ǝnga ar ˈyiˈyi ta har tsi mazǝma ja a dǝmǝlmau.

Ba ji sǝmku fǝla ǝnga thlǝmǝr ndǝra aˈyi baˈanuwa, ndǝra mǝliya dǝmǝlmau ǝnga sǝra a gwa patǝu, ǝnga duniya ǝnga sǝra a gwa patǝu, ǝnga dǝl ǝnga sǝra a gwa patǝu, ji na, “Tsu vanyi sana pǝci aˈyi mai.
Ama ar pǝci kǝra waladi nǝ mǝɗǝfǝkura nyi wu nda mbǝɗǝ tǝlǝmǝ tugu nyi, sǝra aˈyi ɗǝɗǝwa nǝ Hyal wu nda nyabiya dzau ar babal, ǝnggǝr kǝra ji nana, anǝ njir mǝl thlǝr nyi, nabiˈyar.”
Kǝ ɗahǝ ta yi saya nggar ta, sara dǝmǝlmǝ ta, ɓǝra ndǝr anǝ ɗa wayu, ji na, “Maˈyi, ga gwa hǝri zǝr lǝkakaɗǝ papahǝ ta, kǝra wu tsa waladi ta, kǝra aˈyi taˈyi a gwar dǝl ǝnga ar ˈyiˈyi.”

Tǝma, kǝ yi maˈyi a ndǝgya waladiya nyi, yi nda yiwa aga ja nǝ ɗa zǝr lǝkakaɗa nyi. Əngwar ja anǝ ɗa, “Hǝri ba ga ɗǝhu. Ju nda shabiya ta gau ja ɗa ɗǝwatǝu, ama wu miya gau wu nda ɗa nǝnǝmǝu ǝnggǝr ciɗi.”
Kǝ yi dlǝwuri zǝr lǝkakaɗa nyi, sara wu tsa waladiya nyi, ba yi ɗǝhu. Ta yi fuwa a du miya yau ba ji ɗa nǝnǝmǝu wu miya yau ǝnggǝr ciɗi, ama ta yi tasǝya ba ji ɗa ɗǝwatǝu a gyu ta yau.
Kǝ nji nar ɗa, “Kǝl ya ɓǝra habiya ndǝr ar kǝra nji pamǝpamǝ gangǝu, ǝnga ˈyiˈyi ˈyiˈyi pamǝpamǝ ǝnga miya pamǝpamǝ ba ǝnga tǝl tǝl pampamǝu.”
